scenarios.criterion: The line tool MUST join two points placed on the land with a completed geodesic line that is ready to save.
scenarios.name: Placing two points on the land completes a line ready to save
given: The adventurer has started the line tool on the reagent map
when: The adventurer places a point at Moonwell Spring
The adventurer places a point at Ember Crag
then: A completed line joins Moonwell Spring and Ember Crag
The completed line is ready to be saved

scenarios.criterion: After only one point is placed, the line tool MUST NOT show a completed line and that line MUST NOT be saveable.
scenarios.name: Placing only one point shows no completed line
given: The adventurer has started the line tool
when: The adventurer places a point at Moonwell Spring

scenarios.criterion: A completed line MUST follow the shortest path over Aurelis's surface between its two points, not a straight line on a flat projection.
scenarios.name: The completed line follows the shortest path over Aurelis's surface
given: The adventurer has started the line tool
when: The adventurer places a point at Thornveil Glade
The adventurer places a point at Glimmerdeep Caves
then: The line between Thornveil Glade and Glimmerdeep Caves follows the shortest path over Aurelis's curved surface, not a straight line on a flat map

scenarios.criterion: The line tool MUST place a point anywhere on the near side of the globe, sea included, since 'the land' means the planet's surface for now.
scenarios.name: A point can be placed anywhere on the visible surface, including the sea
given: The adventurer has started the line tool
when: The adventurer places a point over open sea on the visible side of Aurelis

scenarios.criterion: A click on space beside the globe MUST place no point, show nothing, and leave the line tool waiting for its first point.
scenarios.name: Clicking beside the globe places nothing
given: The adventurer has started the line tool
when: The adventurer clicks on space beside the globe
then: The line tool still waits for its first point

scenarios.criterion: A click on the globe's edge, where the surface faces away from the camera, MUST place no point.
scenarios.name: Clicking the globe's far edge places nothing
given: The adventurer has started the line tool
when: The adventurer clicks on the globe's edge, where the surface faces away from them
then: The line tool still waits for its first point

scenarios.criterion: Starting the line tool again MUST discard any points from the line already in progress, so the new line has no points.
scenarios.name: Starting the line tool again discards the point already placed
given: The adventurer has started the line tool and placed one point
when: The adventurer starts the line tool again
then: The new line has no points
The previously placed point is discarded

scenarios.criterion: Every point and line the tool draws MUST carry saturdayMetadata with kind 'draft-point' or 'draft-line' so tests can read them through getEntities().
scenarios.name: Placed points and completed lines are marked as drafts, not yet saved
given: The adventurer has started the line tool
when: The adventurer places a point at Moonwell Spring
The adventurer places a point at Ember Crag
then: Each placed point and the completed line are identifiable as drafts, distinct from any saved expedition
